description: This file defines the UserController class in a Spring Boot application, handling user-related HTTP requests such as registration, deletion, email and password updates. It interacts with UserService, EmailService, and handles exceptions related to user management.

classes.name: UserController
classes.description: RestController handling user-related API endpoints such as registration, deletion, email, and password updates.

methods.name: emailExists
methods.description: Checks if an email is registered in the system.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Handles user registration, sends confirmation email.

methods.name: deleteCurrentUser
methods.description: Deletes the currently authenticated user after password verification, sends confirmation email.

methods.name: updateEmail
methods.description: Updates the email address of the current user after verifying current password.

methods.name: updatePassword
methods.description: Updates the password of the current user after verifying current password, sends confirmation email.
